format: pmtiles: one archive of Terrarium-encoded PNG raster-dem tiles, z5-12, 256 px

upstream.notes: USGS 3DEP 1 arc-second seamless DEM, 1x1 degree GeoTIFFs from https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Elevation/1/TIFF/current/ (77 cells including one ring of neighbours, ~3,900 MB for Kansas). Built with --source 1: z12 pixels are ~30 m anyway, and the 1/3 arc-second product is ~9x the download. Quarterly at most; a rebuild is a deliberate workflow_dispatch. TNM Access API: https://tnmaccess.nationalmap.gov/api/v1/products

notes: Rebuilt 2026-11-10 with one ring of neighbouring 3DEP cells (build_topo.py CELL_RING) so edge tiles have real terrain past the bbox: 539,794,634 bytes, sha256 46bc9ad6b2917472a93a223e4a9be9b8fcdcdbb952eb989cf4bcdb0504993b1c. Interior tiles are byte-identical to the previous build; 8 edge tiles changed. One file: elevation only, as Terrarium raster-dem (height_m = R*256 + G + B/256 - 32768; sea and no-data 0 m). Contours and hillshade are drawn on the phone from these tiles, so there is no separate vector-contour or hillshade pack. Builder needs no GDAL or tippecanoe (numpy, tifffile, imagecodecs, Pillow, pmtiles).
